page.layout: One page of text, one column. A centred title block of several lines at the top, set in capitals and italic capitals, then the body text below it, opening with a large decorated initial. No margin notes. Catchword at the lower right, signature mark at the lower left.

main_text.head: NOBILISSIMIS, AMPLISSIMIS, CONSULTISSIMIS, FLORENTISSIMÆ LEYDENSIUM REIPUBLICÆ QUATUORVIRIS COSS. QUIQUE EORUM A CONSILIIS ET SECRETIS.
main_text.p: NON patrocinium quæro, non charisticum emendico, non gratiam aucupor vestram, AMPLISSIMI PROCERES. Quorum illud, ab innocuo argumento; istud, à genio & fortunâ etiā meâ,

page.notes: The title block is set in mixed small capitals and italic capitals; it is given as one heading. The initial N is a large decorated woodcut letter, joined to the word NON. The signature mark reads as an asterisk followed by a figure 3; uncertain. The word meâ ends the page with a comma or dash mark that is hard to read; written as a comma. The catchword "hoc" is printed at the lower right. No page number is printed.
